## IRouteMetricsConfig.routeBlacklist property

A list of routes that will be excluded from metrics collection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
routeBlacklist?: readonly (string | RegExp)[];
```

## Default Value

`undefined`

## Remarks

When `registeredRoutesOnly` is `false`<!-- -->, patterns are also matched against the raw request URL for requests that did not match a registered route. Keep patterns linear-time. RegExp entries with the `g` or `y` flag are copied internally and matched statelessly (`lastIndex` is reset before each test); the original objects are never modified.
